platform: windows/amd64; a native executable -- no container, no Compose model, no image digest

collector.binary_execution_scope: run from a private directory with an isolated config against a loopback receiver by scripts/check_windows_agent.py; never installed as a service, never pointed at production ingest

provenance.method: download the asset named in collector.asset -> hash the download and compare it with the publisher's own checksum file (publisher_checksum_url) -> list the archive members and reject absolute or traversal paths -> extract otelcol-contrib.exe and hash it -> compare with collector.binary_sha256 -> only then install. Each step refuses; the recipe and its commands are in CONTRACT.md.
provenance.checksum_checked_against: the .sha256 asset served by the same GitHub release, not a third-party mirror and not the file named in this repository
provenance.signature_verification: not performed. A sigstore bundle (<asset>.sigstore.json) is published beside the release asset and this repository ships no sigstore/cosign dependency, so nothing here verifies it. No signature and no registry publication is claimed for this component.
provenance.distribution: one GitHub release asset fetched over HTTPS; the estate builds nothing here and publishes nothing

windows_event_log.stability: alpha (logs only); unsupported on darwin and linux
windows_event_log.present_in_pinned_build: otelcol-contrib.exe components lists windows_event_log from module .../receiver/windowseventlogreceiver v0.159.0 (measured 2026-09-08)
windows_event_log.channel_and_query_refusal: either `channel` or `query` must be set, but not both
windows_event_log.used_by: collector-security.yaml, an opt-in overlay that collector.yaml does not load

options_not_selected.event_driven_scraping: alpha feature gate stanza.windows.eventDrivenScraping, off in the pinned build's default gate list
options_not_selected.resolve_sids: adds LSA calls per event; not validated here, so SIDs arrive unresolved
options_not_selected.remote: collection over the network needs its own permissions review
options_not_selected.exclude_providers: the query bounds the read; provider exclusion is a noise knob, not a privacy one
options_not_selected.path: reads an .evtx archive instead of a live channel

upstream.why_not_the_newest: the front door, the store collector and this agent are one contrib version; the remediation ledger records the 0.159.0 -> 0.160.0 move as pending-data-pass (store-signoz versions.json, validation.collector_upgrade), and a pin moves on its own branch with a reason and a rollback line, never inside another component's change

validated.security_channel: overlay loads and carries an event with stable identity on a non-Security channel; Security-channel delivery, service installation, and native upgrade/restore are not run -- see conformance.md and CONTRACT.md
